rationale: For each bus, computed reactive power requirement to reach target voltage 0.98 pu using linear sensitivity. Bus 2: deficit 0.036 pu / 0.0016 pu_per_kvar = 22.5 kvar, within aggregate EV capability (25.36 kvar). Bus 3: deficit 0.028 pu / 0.0012 pu_per_kvar = 23.33 kvar, clipped to EV capability (13.86 kvar). Corrected voltages calculated as base + q_dispatch * sensitivity.
